Lemma
[Regularity of the weighted Hessian] Source: chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0099, chow-et-al-ricci-flow-part-iv:page-0100 ↗ lem:chow-iv-weighted-higher-pressure-estimates 1. ch29:29.11\group Pressure Estimates

For $p<\infty $ and $\alpha \in (0,1)$, uniformly for $t\le -1$, \[ \| v abla ^2v\| _{W^{1,p}}\le C(p),\qquad \| v abla ^2v\| _{C^\alpha }+\| v\Delta _{S^2}v\| _{C^\alpha }\le C(\alpha ). \]
